name: FULONGMA GROUP Co.,Ltd.
summary: FULONGMA GROUP Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sanitation equipment under the FULONGMA brand in China and internationally. It operates through Environmental And Ecological Industry Operation; Smart Equipment; and Others segments. The company offers compression refuse collectors, dock with self-discharging garbage trucks, movable refuse compactors, detachable container garbage collectors, self-loading garbage trucks, sealed garbage bin carriers, garbage bin carriers, waste crushing trucks, and kitchen garbage trucks; dirty-suction vehicles, high-pressure sprinklers, cleaning sweeper trucks, multi-functional dust suppression trucks, pavement maintaining trucks,…
